user_prompt: I need to pull together our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review, and at the same time, I need to log and track some equipment upgrades we're rolling out across departments to stay audit-ready. Can you help me access both of those workflows in a single request?

steps.step_name: I need to access and review our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review.

result_preview.title: Benefits Enrollment Data Management API

result_preview.title: Payroll Data Exposure API
result_preview.shortDescription: Exposes payroll records, earnings, deductions, and tax information for employees.
result_preview.description: This API retrieves and manages payroll-related data including earnings history, deduction details, tax withholdings, and compensation components for workforce members. It provides access to detailed payroll records that integrate with downstream HR and financial systems, enabling real-time payroll status queries and historical compensation data retrieval.
useCases: Calculate financial burden of safety incidents on payroll and benefits
HR manager ensures production team members are assigned and their labor hours are tracked for payroll and cost accounting.
Assess cost implications of employee reassignment for incident investigation
Determine budget impact of compliance remediation on HR operations
Production workforce allocation and payroll integration ensures accurate labor cost attribution to customer orders.

result_preview.title: Benefits Enrollment Data Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves employee benefits enrollment records and eligibility data.
result_preview.description: This API exposes comprehensive benefits enrollment information for employees and workforce persons, enabling external systems to retrieve current enrollment status, plan selections, and eligibility determinations. It provides access to historical enrollment decisions and allows querying of benefits coverage details tied to individual workforce members.
useCases: Reconcile benefits enrollment data with compensation budgets
Calculate total cost of employment including benefit obligations
Validate benefit-related compensation adjustments for open enrollment

result_preview.title: Compensation and Salary Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages employee compensation structures, salary data, and payroll integration.
result_preview.description: Exposes comprehensive compensation and salary information for employees and workforce persons. Retrieves salary bands, variable compensation, bonuses, and payroll-relevant attributes. Manages compensation planning data and provides access to salary history and payroll integration touchpoints.
useCases: Payroll and HR systems update employee earnings to reflect overtime, new role classifications, or performance adjustments tied to production change success.
Workforce planners align compensation structures with modified labor requirements in manufacturing operations.

result_preview.title: Equipment Change and Service Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages equipment changes, service requests, and maintenance governance.
result_preview.description: Exposes change requests, IT equipment records, and service tickets to coordinate equipment modifications and maintenance activities across the manufacturing facility. Retrieves approval workflows and risk assessments for equipment changes while managing service ticket lifecycle and equipment diagnostics integration.
useCases: IT Service Management ensures production equipment remains operational during peak order fulfillment.
Facility operations teams must plan and execute maintenance of safety systems that protect workers from identified hazardous substances
Operations teams prioritize critical equipment service requests affecting fulfillment SLAs.
Manufacturing facilities schedule preventive maintenance to minimize unplanned downtime.

result_preview.title: Safety Change Governance Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves change requests, equipment assets, and service tickets for safety compliance governance.
result_preview.description: Exposes change request workflows, IT equipment inventories, and service ticket lifecycles to enforce safety governance controls. Provides access to approval workflows and risk assessments for infrastructure changes that impact environmental and occupational safety. Retrieves integrated data on equipment maintenance status and incident-related service tickets to support regulatory compliance tracking.
